sentences.text: Claims arising within 30 days of the first policy commencement date are not covered, except claims arising from an accident.
Pre-existing diseases are covered only after a waiting period of 48 months of continuous coverage.
Specified illnesses such as cataract, hernia and joint replacement are covered after a waiting period of 24 months.
Room rent is covered up to 1% of the sum insured per day.
Cosmetic or plastic surgery is not covered unless it is needed to treat an injury from an accident.
A planned hospitalisation must be intimated to the insurer at least 48 hours before admission.
A grace period of 30 days is allowed for renewal premium payment.
